name: gazzumatteo-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Matteo Gazzurelli — testing, automation, and productivity tools for NQL and beyond

plugins.name: e2e-testing
plugins.description: End-to-end testing workflow: create checklists from code, validate them against changes, and execute via Playwright. Unifies cloud (Claude) and local (LM Studio) executors behind a single `/run-checklist` dispatcher. v0.6.0 ships a single unified `.testing.yml` config (replaces `.e2e-testing.env` + `.e2e-testing.yml` + `TESTING_CREDENTIALS.md`) — same file is shared with mobile-testing. Includes the `e2e-vision` MCP server with `analyze_image(path, prompt)` to offload PNG analysis to LM Studio (~30 tokens vs ~1800 for inline Read). Structured markdown + JSON reports.

plugins.name: code-optimizer
plugins.description: Scan, plan, apply, and verify code optimizations across 11 categories (dedup, type consolidation, dead code, cycles, type strengthening, error handling, AI-slop, complexity, magic constants, naming, excessive parameters). Multi-language (TS/JS, Python, generic). Regression-safe via baseline + per-batch rollback.

plugins.name: mobile-testing
plugins.description: Direct iOS Simulator and Android Emulator control without MobAI desktop app — zero rate limits. Pluggable backends: native (xcrun simctl + adb + Quartz) and Appium (XCUITest + UIAutomator2). v0.2.0 ships a single unified `.testing.yml` config (replaces `.mobile-testing.env`) — same file is shared with e2e-testing. Includes `analyze_screenshot` / `analyze_image` MCP tools to offload PNG analysis to LM Studio (~30 tokens vs ~1800 for inline Read). Single `/mobile-runner` dispatcher auto-routes cloud vs local. Same 14 device-control tools and DSL v0.2 as MobAI MCP.
